source_population.population: Selected 2019 rural Yanlou/Shandong follow-up, age 61-80, free of dementia and functional disability; known diabetes included. Demographics/BMI collected in 2018, laboratory measurements in 2019. Source context: CTX_MIND_ANALYZED. Reported marginal sample count is source-specific, not target size or a guaranteed regression/pair count.
source_population.measurement: {"BMI": "kg/m^2, prior-year assessment", "FPG_distinction": "Separate plasma hexokinase measurement; never alias it to FSG.", "FSG": "serum, glucose oxidase CS-600B, mmol/L, local laboratory within two hours", "HbA1c_percent": "EDTA whole blood, HPLC Huizhong MQ6000, percent, KingMed within two days", "age": "years; source timing retained as reported", "fasting": "overnight, exact hours unreported", "gender": "reported female count"} Original weights: not_reported. Mean filling of continuous and mode filling of categorical variables reported; affected field counts/effects and correlation tie implementation unreported.

transfer: Fixed MIND marginal anchors are a declared scenario for the task population, with no claim of equality to target empirical moments. Source sample selection, imputation and prior-year BMI are not reproduced.
uncertainty: Source estimator uncertainty is not reported; individual SDs remain individual dispersion. Source age margins and other sources are contextual only. No precision weighting or independent-source replication count is inferred.
overlap: The seven numerically used items are one source analysis. Mean/SD pairs and their algebraic lognormal transformations are dependent representations. The packet does not identify their sampling covariance. No cross-source statistical pooling occurs.
identification: Source first/second margins and female count ratio identify only their original descriptive summaries. Target transport, age mass, lognormal tails and all dependence are assumptions.
